description: This file is a shell script for testing SVN branch names with potential special characters and encoding issues. It sets up an SVN repository structure, creates various branches with complex names, and then tests cloning and committing to those branches using Git via 'git svn'.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided shell commands.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Potentially starts an HTTP server for SVN repository access, used in testing environments.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of prerequisites, such as MinGW, to conditionally run parts of the script.
